ISRO's big news this week is the NVS-03 navigation satellite, set to launch on Fri 30 Oct on a GSLV Mk II rocket from Sriharikota.

Announcement: ISRO said on Thu 22 Oct that it plans the launch for Fri 30 Oct.
Why it matters: NVS-03 is meant to strengthen NavIC, India's own navigation system, and help restore independent positioning services.
Delays: Indian Express calls it a much-delayed satellite, so the date could still move.
Rocket name: One site calls the rocket GSLV-F18; the others just say GSLV Mk II.

This comes from search result summaries, not the full articles. I found no launch time, so check isro.gov.in closer to the day.
